name: Treaty with the Potawatomi, 1832 (Treaty of Tippecanoe, 27 October)
nations: Potawatomi of Indiana and Michigan (Bodéwadmi), including Pokagon's band and the Nottawaseppi band
promises: Reservations kept from the cession, including one at Pokagon's village for his band and one for the Potawatomi at Nottawaseppi (Article II).
Grants of land by patent to named persons (Article III).
$15,000 a year for twelve years, $32,000 in goods soon after signing and $10,000 in goods the next spring at Nottawaseppi, and payment of listed debts of $20,721 (Article IV).
An annual $2,000 for educating Indian youths (Article IV).

breaches.what: The Indian Claims Commission found that for the Potawatomi interest in Royce Area 181 ceded by this treaty, lands with a fair market value of $862,967.10, the United States paid $242,998.00 in consideration plus $39,250.64 for food, rations and provisions, and that this was so grossly inadequate as to render the consideration unconscionable.
breaches.whoFoundIt: Indian Claims Commission, Citizen Band of Potawatomi Indians et al. v. United States, Dockets 128 et al., Opinion and Order Setting Awards of 8 September 1978 (43 Ind. Cl. Comm. 74)

source.title: Citizen Band of Potawatomi Indians v. United States, Dockets 128 et al., Opinion of the Commission (1978)

breaches.quote: so grossly inadequate as to render the consideration unconscionable

landTaken: Royce Area 181 in northern Indiana. The Commission divided it into Tract *5 (260,134 acres, all Potawatomi) and Tract Y-3 (575,866 acres, half Potawatomi and half Miami); the Potawatomi interest was valued as of 21 January 1833.
compensation: The Potawatomi award of $4,497,815.59 set on 8 September 1978 covers four cessions together (1826, 1828, 26 October 1832 and this treaty), less any offsets.
today: The Commission certified Dockets 128 et al. to the Court of Claims on 29 September 1978, according to the collection index.

openQuestions: The collection index dates the opinion 28 September 1978, but the Order Setting Awards dated 8 September 1978 says the opinion was entered the same day; 8 September is used.
The transfer order and the Court of Claims outcome were not opened.
treaties.json lists Royce cessions 188, 190, 201, 204, 208 and 221 to 225 under this id as well as 181; only Area 181 was traced.
Statements by the Pokagon Band or the Nottawaseppi Huron Band on this treaty were not looked for in the time available.
